package main

import (
	"log"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"github.com/maarifnu/dapodik_api/internal/config"
	"github.com/maarifnu/dapodik_api/internal/database"
	"github.com/maarifnu/dapodik_api/internal/handler"
	"github.com/maarifnu/dapodik_api/internal/middleware"
)

func main() {
	// Load configuration
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error loading config: %v", err)
	}

	// Connect to database
	db, err := database.New(cfg.Database)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Database connection error: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	// Initialise handler with dependencies
	h := handler.New(db)

	// Setup Gin router (without default logger — we use our own)
	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(gin.Recovery())
	r.Use(middleware.RequestResponseLogger())

	// Register routes
	api := r.Group(cfg.App.Path)
	api.Use(middleware.TokenRequired(cfg.Auth.ValidToken))
	{
		api.GET("/:npsn", h.GetDataByNPSN)
		api.DELETE("/:npsn", h.DeleteData)
		api.POST("", h.InsertData)
	}

	log.Printf("Server starting on %s", cfg.App.Port)
	if err := r.Run(cfg.App.Port); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Server failed: %v", err)
	}
}
